c: Dark Frogamorphosis places a circular dark purple aura around the player that pulls particles and pulses inward, alternating between one and two pulses, dealing damage to enemies inside it. Frogs no longer spawn normally. Instead, each enemy that enters the aura can be pulled in by a tongue and be eaten, which also morphs them into a green frog.

Enemies resistant to Rosary are excluded from the pool of enemies the tongue projectile can select from. When an enemy is morphed into a frog, it despawns the enemy and adds the enemy's health to the weapon's current inflicted damage directly, rather than dealing damage to the enemy. After a 400ms delay, a frog is spawned where the enemy was.

Cooldown acts similarly to Hitbox Delay for the aura. Damage will be dealt instantly to an enemy if they have never been in the circle before, after which they cannot be hit by it again until Dark Frogamorphosis's Cooldown is over, even if they temporarily leave its area.

Enemies hit by the aura will take more knockback and be more vulnerable to freeze. If the enemy is not immune to debuff, each hit applies +0.3 knockback to the enemy until the maximum knockback they can take and -0.1 to freeze resistance until it reaches 0.

The debuffs applied by Dark Frogamorphosis' aura are its most useful ability late game. Strong enemies that take multiple hits to kill will be easier to keep at bay thanks to increased knockback, and some boss enemies can become vulnerable to freezing when kept in the circle for long enough.
Combined with a weapon to constantly knock enemies away, such as
, Dark Frogamorphosis can enable the player to sit entirely still.

has natural synergy with Dark Frogamorphosis; it decreases the enemy's resistance to freezing, allowing the Clock Lancet to freeze bosses, and even very powerful frozen enemies can easily be killed by keeping Dark Frogamorphosis's area of effect over them.
If the player intends to stay idle, Dark Frogamorphosis works well when paired with the
, as enemies that die instantly to Dark Frogamorphosis may drop experience just out of reach of the player.
The aura can kill most weak enemies instantly. Killing swarms of weak enemies can lead to windfalls of Little Hearts which can increase the damage output of Dark Frogamorphosis.
Because Dark Frogamorphosis does not count any overhealing, you have to occasionally take damage and heal back up in order to gain stacks. Due to this, it does not pair well with
(for instance), the player can take less risk in taking a lot of damage, just to heal up easily to empower Dark Frogamorphosis.
